resource_scope: Extra experimental inline capacity blockCacheBytes/64/2; bitmap /512 allocated only after eligible strict parse. Base4096+bitmap boxed length+1024 per completed entry+payload length conservatively accounted. No first-sighting trees, no new workers/persistent growth. RSS/HWM are whole process, not isolated cache cost.
decision_basis: Normal SDK cold arrays still regress latency/CPU 5.21%/4.63%. Longer 2000-key cold arrays improve 17.50%/10.46%, but scalar SDK latency/CPU regress 15.30%/14.18%, eight callers 4.84%/4.27%. Large native arrays improve mean 5.91-62.41% and CPU 44.16-58.81%; every adverse scalar/tail leg remains. Mixed outcomes reject adoption.
causal_limit: Removing first-sighting tree allocations did not consistently remove regressions. Dispatch, eligibility/hash coordination, parser and changed code layout remain candidates; no exclusive cause inferred from inclusive spans. Native array gain confirms an internal repeated-JSON seam beyond SDK conversion.
alternatives: SHA, CRC, and delayed-tree variants (previously rejected).
